metadata.title: Integrate a newly released model

applicability.scope: New model support in an existing inference engine.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Per-stage parity report, supported-feature matrix, end-to-end output and replayable regression fixture.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.

body.json.text:
{
  "task": "day0-model",
  "title": "Integrate a newly released model",
  "choose_when": "First usable support for a new checkpoint or model architecture in an existing engine.",
  "required_inputs": [
    "checkpoint revision and tokenizer or processor",
    "model family and supported modalities",
    "upstream reference outputs",
    "device, backend and engine revisions"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Map the model config and I/O contract to the host engine.",
    "Run the smallest reference-parity test for each requested modality.",
    "List missing operators or unsupported features before benchmarking."
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence": "A reproducible load and generation smoke, parity checks and a supported-feature matrix on the named target.",
  "candidate_skill_ids": [
    "ascend-model-adaptation",
    "diffusers-invocation-state",
    "claim-contract"
  ]
}
